title: DDU Clinical Services and Supports Request for Proposals
agency_path: City of New York > Administration for Children's Services
description_text:
The ACS Developmental Disabilities Unit (DDU) Clinical Services and Supports RFP seeks one vendor to provide, psychological evaluations which include, full scale IQ and adaptive testing scores, psychosocial assessments, and autism testing to children, adolescents, and adults with a suspicion of I/DD and are in need of documentation for services or are I/DD documented and are in need of home/community-based and clinic-based services. The evaluations will take place in either a home/community-based or a clinic-based setting, located within the five boroughs of New York City and surrounding counties.

This Request for Proposals (RFP) is issued through the PASSPort system. To apply to this RFP and all other solicitations, organizations must have an account in PASSPort. Proposals will ONLY be accepted through PASSPort. If you do not have a PASSPort account, please visit www.nyc.gov/passport to get started.
